ext:name: Workflow
ext:hint: Every console URL the three views above do not name a depth for: the console's own root, which redirects to the listing of the homepage every deployment has, and any workflow or version whose homepage is stored deeper than one segment. The named depths cover every homepage a deployment normally has; this one keeps the rest working rather than leaving them unrouted, which is a blank page. Ordered last, so the named depths are the ones the breadcrumb trail finds first - a splat never names a crumb itself, which is what keeps the root out of the trail: it is a way in, not a step above the homepage.
